summary_en: Nippon Kayaku will acquire the remaining shares of Sanko Chemical Industries using a shareholders' call procedure under the Companies Act, raising its ownership from 89.7% to 100% effective October 13, 2026, to strengthen group synergies and enhance operational efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Acquisition of Sanko Chemical Industries Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
Nippon Kayaku announced on September 7, 2026 that it will acquire all remaining shares of Sanko Chemical Industries Co., Ltd. to establish full ownership. The company will exercise a shareholders' call procedure under Article 179 of the Companies Act, with settlement scheduled for October 13, 2026. Nippon Kayaku's ownership will increase from 89.7% (as of September 7, 2026) to 100%. The company previously held 45.0% as of March 2026.

Sanko Chemical Industries, based in Kanagawa Prefecture, operates a methyl bromide business and real estate rental operations with capital of 21 million yen. The acquisition aims to strengthen coordination between the companies and enhance group operational efficiency and resource allocation. Nippon Kayaku expects to recognize negative goodwill but anticipates the amount will be immaterial and is under final review.
